bootstrap: target: B = 2,000 over targets, seed-mean of split seeds 0-4 (registered); two_level: same target draws x per-seed resampling of C_a and C_b cells (robustness; conservative on small control thirds)

H3a.rule: Rejected if the 95 % target-bootstrap CI (B = 2,000; mean over 5 split seeds) of D_other or D_perm at k = 8 is not entirely above 0, or the control-only negative control (numerator form scaled by the observed denominator) yields D >= 50 % of the observed D.
